;International relations
*[[Lithuania–United States relations]]:
**[[Lithuania]] signs a trade agreement to buy [[liquefied natural gas]] from the [[United States]] in a move aimed at reducing the [[EU]] [[Baltic state]]'s heavy dependence on [[Russia]]n gas deliveries. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/02/28/lithuania-lng-usa-idUSL5N0W207O20150228 (Reuters)]
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**[[Venezuela]] [[President of Venezuela|president]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] announces new sanctions on the [[United States]], including visa restrictions. He stated that Americans would have to obtain visas in order to enter Venezuela. Furthermore, Maduro announced that former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[George W. Bush]], former [[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] [[Dick Cheney]], former [[Director of Central Intelligence|CIA Director]] [[George Tenet]], and [[United States Senate|U.S. Senators]] [[Bob Menendez]] ([[Democratic Party (United States)|D]]–[[New Jersey|NJ]]) and [[Marco Rubio]] ([[Republican Party (United States)|R]]–[[Florida|FL]]) would be banned from entering the country. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-usa/maduro-says-venezuela-detains-u-s-citizens-announces-moves-against-u-s-idUSKBN0LX10J20150301 (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-31679888 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*The municipal intermediate people’s court for the eastern city of [[Dongying]] convicts [[Ni Fake]], former Vice-Governor of [[Anhui]] province in China, on charges of bribery and "amassing wealth of unclear origin", and sentences him to seventeen years in prison. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/feb/28/china-jails-ex-vice-governor-for-corruption (''The Guardian'')] 
*The [[Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference]] removes disgraced senior official [[Ling Jihua]] from the office of Vice-Chairman and also strips him of his ordinary delegate status. [http://www.straitstimes.com/news/asia/east-asia/story/top-china-advisory-body-cppcc-ousts-former-top-hu-jintao-aide-ling-jihua-2 (''Straits Times'')]
